channels.title: Source catalog
channels.lead: A channel is a place data can be fetched from, with how to fetch it and its rules. Adding one is registering a record, not changing code; only approved channels are used, tried in this order.
channels.howItWorks: Run a trial before approving; approve only when it shows results, and say why. A channel that fails {n} times in a row is paused automatically; its jobs wait and continue after it resumes. Disabling it turns waiting demands into “unsatisfiable”.
channels.registered: Registered and pending review. Run a trial, then review.

sites.title: Sites to review
sites.lead: Web pages are reviewed per site: a URL on an unregistered site creates a pending channel automatically, and the demand waits for review.
sites.howItWorks: Each site is reviewed once; afterwards the same site follows that channel. Unreviewed for {days} days, the waiting demands become “unsatisfiable” and users are told.
sites.none: No sites are waiting for review.

alert.too_many_pending: {count} or more sites are waiting for review.
alert.waiting_too_long: A site has been waiting for more than {hours} hours.

gaps.title: Gap list
gaps.lead: Unsatisfiable demands grouped by type, to decide which channels to add. Counts only; it does not show who asked.
gaps.howItWorks: “Not covered yet” means no channel in the catalog can supply it (or the one that could is disabled) and is the main reason to add channels; “the channel has no such document” and “site rejected or never reviewed” are listed too.

queue.title: Queue monitor
queue.lead: Per channel: jobs queued, running and waiting to retry, done and failed in a day, and recent failure reasons.

event.site_found: A user's URL was on this site; created as pending

form.name: Name

done.resume: Resumed; waiting jobs were queued again.
done.disable: Disabled; waiting demands are now unsatisfiable.

detail.trialLead: Run one list and one fetch for a sample description; approve only when it shows results. Trials run in the background and are neither kept nor delivered.
detail.reviewLead: Each channel is reviewed once. Approving sets the license tier; rejecting turns waiting demands into unsatisfiable. Always say why.
detail.needTrial: The latest trial did not succeed, so it cannot be approved yet.
